summary_en: Arcads provides an AI video advertising platform that transforms text scripts, product images, and prompts into smartphone-style UGC video ads optimized for TikTok, Meta, and YouTube. summary_en: Arcads enables e-commerce brands to generate product-in-hand demonstrations, virtual try-ons, and unboxing-style video ads starting from a single static product image. summary_en: Arcads includes a Batch Creation workflow that crosses multiple script hooks with different AI actors to render dozens of video ad variations in a single run.
